title: aspectNames
description: The aspect name a JMRI signal mast driver publishes for an indication: rows keyed by JMRI signal system (the symbol field JMRI.SignalSystem), then indication; a row is one name for every mast Kind, or a map by Kind (CONTROLLED, ABSOLUTE, PERMISSIVE) where the system folds the plate into the name. An indication with no row is not presentable in that system.

table.description: The table's name, the file's stem; provenance.referenceData of a layout file names it.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the file is written to. 0 until the KiCad importer and FieldUnit work end to end; no bump rules before then (the owner, 2026-11-13).

version.description: The table's provenance date, with .n when it was revised again that day. A layout file names it in provenance.referenceData.<table>.version.

provenance.description: Where the rows come from: the owner's ruling, the document and date, or the standard opened.
